title: Fourier norm of restriction coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a subset of its coordinates, and let $S$ be a subset of $J$. Regard the Fourier coefficient of the restriction of $f$ with free-coordinate frequency $S$ as a function of the signs fixed outside $J$. The Fourier one-norm, on the cube of fixed coordinates, of this coefficient function is at most the Fourier one-norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinate set
